title.purpose: Thread names, panel heroes, card headings.

meta.purpose: Handles, timestamps, previews, status lines; tabular-nums for clocks.

shadows.name: composer-focus
shadows.purpose: Both composers on :focus-within, with a foreground-mixed border.

shadows.name: bubble
shadows.purpose: Message bubbles; the only shadowed inline element.

shadows.name: docked-overlay
shadows.purpose: Info panel overlaying the thread below 1240px container width.

shadows.name: lightbox
shadows.purpose: Lightbox image on the 82% black veil.

shadows.name: admin-shell
shadows.purpose: Admin Control Room shell; the whole operator surface lifts as one object.

shadows.name: admin-inspector
shadows.purpose: Member inspector only when it overlays the ledger; becomes -28px 0 80px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.48) as the phone drawer.

shadows.name: admin-save-state
shadows.purpose: Sticky instance-policy save state above scrolling control ledgers.

motion.name: ease-social
motion.purpose: The only easing on the surface: thumb slide, view swaps, message enter, panel slide, share sheet, heart pop, hover lifts.

motion.name: duration-message
motion.purpose: Message enter: translateY(7px) + fade. Also share-sheet editor and group modal card rise.

motion.name: duration-sheet
motion.purpose: Share-sheet card in (translateY(14px) scale(0.985)); scrim 220ms fade.

motion.name: loop-presence-pulse
motion.purpose: Presence dot ring: box-shadow 0 0 0 0 rgb(94 232 144 / 0.45) -> 0 0 0 7px transparent. One of two permitted loops.

motion.name: loop-equalizer
motion.purpose: 3-bar listening equalizer (2px bars, staggered -0.35s/-0.55s delays). The other permitted loop.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Buttons, tools, pins, send. Active press: scale(0.94). Chat row hover: translateX(2px).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> animation: none; transition: none
motion.purpose: Kill-list covers equalizer, pulse, heart, message rows, views, thumb, sheet, scrim, modal, comments, snippet editor, info panel.

motion.name: ease-admin
motion.purpose: Admin overview reveal, member inspector attachment, bulk-action entry, and dirty save-state movement.

motion.name: admin-state-transitions
motion.value: overview 440ms clip reveal; inspector 280ms translateX(12px); bulk bar 220ms translateY(6px); health pulse 2.8s
motion.purpose: Bounded Admin-only motion; the pulse is its sole loop and communicates live health.

motion.name: admin-reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> 0.01ms duration; 1 iteration; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Scoped to #page-admin including pseudo-elements; JavaScript inspector scrolling also switches from smooth to auto.

breakpoints.name: container-info-dock
breakpoints.purpose: Info panel leaves the grid and becomes a right overlay (min(340px, 88%)) — container query on #page-social, not a media query.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Messages workspace collapses to one pane; rail/thread swap via .has-thread; back chevron appears; feed posts tighten.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Workspace height calc(100dvh - 250px), radius 16px, info panel full-width shadowless, share sheet 16px radius, message stacks 86%.

breakpoints.name: admin-inspector-overlay
breakpoints.purpose: Admin rail narrows, status becomes 2-by-2, policy ledgers stack, and the member inspector overlays the table at min(340px, 88%).

breakpoints.name: admin-local-index
breakpoints.purpose: Admin shell becomes one column; the local rail becomes a sticky horizontal index and table role/joined metadata collapses.

breakpoints.name: admin-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Metrics become 2-by-2, status and forms stack, the ledger becomes identity-first, and the inspector becomes a fixed edge drawer.

patterns.name: Opaque overlay recipe
patterns.purpose: Every floating card (group modal, share sheet, docked info panel) — opaque and theme-proof.

patterns.name: Change-guarded re-render
patterns.purpose: All list renders (rail, people, messages, feed) compare before assigning to avoid churn.

patterns.name: Optimistic send
patterns.value: temp id `tmp-N` + pending clock tick, replaced by created record / realtime event
patterns.purpose: Messages appear instantly with a clock icon; ticks upgrade to double-check (delivered) and accent double-check (read).

patterns.name: Icon factories
patterns.purpose: JS-rendered markup (js/social-icons.js registry). Static index.html uses <use svg="!lucide/x.svg" size="n"> build-time transform.

patterns.name: escapeHtml everywhere
patterns.value: escapeHtml(...) on every interpolated value incl. attributes
patterns.purpose: All template literals rendering user data.

patterns.name: Scoped [hidden] overrides
patterns.purpose: Legacy span { display: inline-block } outranks the UA [hidden] stylesheet; each affected component re-asserts display:none.

patterns.name: Realtime + polling fallback
patterns.value: pb.collection('*').subscribe with 15s polling fallback; presence heartbeat 30s / 90s active window / 15s progress
patterns.purpose: PocketBase collections: social_profiles, social_presence, social_follows, social_conversations (dm|group), social_messages (kind text|image|track|album|artist|snippet, payload JSON incl snippet {start,end,duration,peaks}), social_posts, social_post_likes, social_post_comments, social_pins, social_mutes, social_reads.

patterns.name: Waveform pipeline
patterns.value: downsamplePeaks(peaks, 96) for cards; DPR-aware canvas (bar width ~6px, 60% fill) reading colors from computed --muted-foreground/--foreground
patterns.purpose: Snippet cards render 96 bars with in-range highlight; share-sheet cropper adds draggable handles (14px hit, 3s min, 30s default).

patterns.name: Admin flat-ledger grammar
patterns.value: status ribbon -> four-cell metric strip -> attached toolbar/table -> permissions/features row ledgers -> instance fields -> sticky save state
patterns.purpose: Preserves the approved option A operator-console order and avoids a generic analytics card mosaic.

patterns.name: Admin semantic chroma
patterns.value: #5ee890 healthy/active/success; #e3b35f degraded/pending; var(--muted-foreground) unknown; var(--destructive) suspended/delete/error
patterns.purpose: Every colored state is paired with plain-language copy; red remains reserved for harmful or failed outcomes.

patterns.name: Admin dialog accessibility
patterns.value: role=dialog + aria-labelledby; aria-modal on phone; inert background; focus close on open; Escape close; focus return to opener
patterns.purpose: The attached inspector becomes a complete modal drawer at the shipped 560px phone condition.

components.name: Social Segmented Tabs

components.css: .ds-tabs { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card) 72%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-family, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 3px; bottom: 3px; left: 3px; width: 62px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--foreground); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), width 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.44rem 1.05rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--background); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']:hover { color: var(--background); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--highlight); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-unread { min-width: 17px; height: 17px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 17px; text-align: center; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] .ds-unread { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); outline: 1px solid var(--border); }

components.name: Admin Policy Switch Row
components.description: Complete policy-ledger label with semantic icon, title, explanatory sentence, and native checkbox switch; the entire row is the target.
components.css: .ds-admin-policy { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 68px; padding: 0.72rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--background) 94%,var(--card)); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-family,Inter,sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-admin-policy:hover { background: rgb(var(--highlight-rgb,245 245 245) / 0.035); } .ds-admin-policy-icon { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted-foreground); background: rgb(var(--highlight-rgb,245 245 245) / 0.025); } .ds-admin-policy-copy { display: grid; gap: 0.18rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-admin-policy-copy strong { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-admin-policy-copy small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.61rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-admin-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; appearance: none; background: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-admin-switch::after { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted-foreground); content: ''; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-admin-switch:checked { border-color: var(--foreground); background: var(--foreground); } .ds-admin-switch:checked::after { background: var(--background); transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-admin-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-admin-policy,.ds-admin-switch,.ds-admin-switch::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview: A private club's noticeboard and mail room, drawn in a single ink. The Social surface never introduces a palette of its own: surfaces are var(--card) over var(--background), structure is 1px hairlines, and the only accent is the foreground itself. Chroma is rationed to two meanings: presence green #5ee890 says a member is alive right now, and like-red #ff5470 says you loved this. Density is messenger-compact with uppercase micro-labels for wayfinding; the feed is naked hairline structure while the messages workspace is the one big contained object. Motion is short, eased, and sparse — 240-320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), one property per move, with only the presence pulse and listening equalizer looping, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Foreground-as-accent: solid ink fills for primary actions, active states, and unread counts
Two chromatic signals only: presence green #5ee890 (alive) and like-red #ff5470 (liked)
Hairline-first structure; rgb(var(--highlight-rgb), a) washes (0.02-0.12) for hover/selected
Feed = flat 660px hairline-divided column; messages = one contained 3-pane workspace
Asymmetric bubble radii (4px toward the sender, 16px elsewhere; 12px when grouped)
WhatsApp-style delivery ticks: clock = pending, double-check = delivered, accent double-check = read
Opaque overlay recipe for every floating card
Info panel docks via a container query on #page-social, not a media query
All JS-rendered markup goes through escapeHtml; re-renders are change-guarded

rules.name: The Foreground-Is-the-Accent Rule
rules.body: The social surface has no brand hue. When something must demand attention, it gets a solid var(--foreground) fill with var(--background) text — never a new color.

rules.name: The Alive-Green Rule
rules.body: #5ee890 means a human is present; #ffffff + glow means they are playing. Neither may ever be decorative, and no other hue may carry a presence meaning.

rules.name: The Wash Ladder
rules.body: Interactive state is rgb(var(--highlight-rgb), a) only: rest 0.02-0.045, hover 0.05-0.09, selected/active 0.09-0.12. Do not invent stronger fills.

rules.name: The Micro-Label Rule
rules.body: Section headers inside panels are never sentence-case headings; they are 0.6rem/750 uppercase with 0.1em tracking in var(--muted-foreground).

rules.name: Names Before Chrome
rules.body: Authors and titles are the heaviest things on screen (650-750 weight); containers stay quiet.

rules.name: The Container Knows Rule
rules.body: Panel docking responds to a container query on #page-social, never a media query — the floating player makes viewport width a lie.

rules.name: One Big Object
rules.body: The feed is naked structure; the messages workspace is the single contained panel. Don't card-ify the feed or unbox the workspace.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for 1px solid var(--border) before any shadow. A shadow on a resting inline surface is a bug; shadows belong to things that float.

rules.name: The Opaque Overlay Rule
rules.body: Every floating card (group modal, share sheet, docked info panel) uses the same recipe: background-color: var(--background); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--card), var(--card)).

dos: Do express every color through tokens (var(--card), var(--border), rgb(var(--highlight-rgb), a), color-mix(...)) so all ten themes work — the fixed hexes #5ee890, #ff5470 are the only exceptions, by contract.
Do use the wash ladder for state: rest 0.02-0.045, hover 0.05-0.09, selected 0.09-0.12.
Do keep motion at 240-320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) with a single transformed property, and register every new animation/transition in the prefers-reduced-motion kill-list block.
Do guard re-renders: if (container.innerHTML !== html) container.innerHTML = html.
Do run all interpolated strings through escapeHtml, including attribute values.
Do use the icon factories — import I_X from '!lucide/x.svg?svg&icon' then I_X(size) in JS-rendered markup; <use svg="!lucide/x.svg" size="n"> in static index.html.
Do use the opaque overlay recipe for any new floating card, and container queries for workspace-relative docking.
Do add a scoped [hidden] { display: none } override when a new component renders inside a span-display rule.
Do cap unread counts at "99+" and debounce library searches (220-240ms).
donts: Don't introduce new hues. Presence green = alive, listening white = playing, like-red = liked. Everything else is the theme's neutrals.
Don't put feed posts in cards — the feed is hairline-divided structure only.
Don't shadow a resting inline surface; shadows are for the workspace shell, composers' focus state, hover-revealed tools, and floating overlays.
Don't dock or reflow the messages workspace with media queries when the condition is really about the workspace's own width — use the container query.
Don't add call UI (video/voice buttons) — mutes and messaging must not grow call features.
Don't send messages without the optimistic path: temp tmp-N id, pending clock tick, replaced by the realtime/created record.
Don't hardcode theme hexes from the default theme into new CSS; they will break the other nine themes.
Don't let loops multiply: the only infinite animations are the presence pulse (2.4s) and the equalizer (0.75s alternate).
